workspace-operations.title: Workspace operations
workspace-operations.loaded_scope: Loaded operations: {{operations}} · Records: {{records}}. This page or live window may contain only part of the history.
workspace-operations.boundary: These records come from the Go workspace host. Development checks, candidate sealing, independent tests and human acceptance remain separate.
workspace-operations.unconfirmed: The latest read is unconfirmed. Previously loaded records remain available for review.
workspace-operations.invalid: Records excluded from this view: {{count}}. Their source or contract could not be verified; inspect the original records.
workspace-operations.empty_filtered: No matching operations in the loaded records.
workspace-operations.empty_loaded: No verified workspace operation records are loaded.
workspace-operations.capture_complete: The host reports complete local capture.
workspace-operations.capture_partial: The host reports partial local capture.
workspace-operations.capture_unknown: The host reports unknown local capture coverage.
workspace-operations.capture_missing: No verified local capture summary was provided. This does not mean zero operations or complete history.
workspace-operations.capture_boundary: Local capture does not prove server acknowledgement or complete page coverage. Pending operations are from the local snapshot.
workspace-operations.inconsistent: Records for this operation conflict. No status can be confirmed; review the original records.
workspace-operations.missing_start: The start record is outside the loaded scope. This is an incomplete operation timeline.
workspace-operations.pending_end: No terminal record is loaded. This does not establish failure or completion.
workspace-operations.replayed: The host replayed the original result. This does not establish a new side effect.
workspace-operations.check_boundary: A completed check operation does not establish a passing check. Review its exit code, stop state and matching generation output. Independent tests and acceptance remain separate.
workspace-operations.check_unavailable: The current final snapshot has no check output matching this operation identity, policy and content generation. Another result with the same check name is not substituted.
workspace-operations.sequence_boundary: Local sequence identifies capture order. Server sequence and saved time identify persisted records; neither is a content-generation ordering.
workspace-operations.error_text: Workspace file must be bounded UTF-8 text.
workspace-operations.error_output_limit: Workspace result exceeds the output limit.
workspace-operations.error_conflict: Workspace file changed. Read it again before editing.
workspace-operations.error_operation_con: Workspace operation identity was used for another request.
workspace-operations.error_checks_stale: Required workspace checks have not passed for current source.
workspace-operations.error_cursor: Workspace list cursor is invalid or stale.
workspace-operations.error_trace_limit: Workspace operation history reached its bounded capacity.
workspace-operations.error_merge_unresol: Resolve every active conflict before continuing the fixed merge.
workspace-operations.error_merge_incompl: All frozen sources must be processed before sealing.
workspace-operations.error_check_failed: The development check returned a nonzero exit code.
workspace-operations.error_check_stopped: The development check process stopped; this does not establish a passing check.
workspace-operations.error_unknown_code: The host returned an unrecognized reason code. Review the original record below.
